 Monarch Muhurat Picks: VAML Among 13 Stocks
 HDFC AMC Rs 2,640 (+5.39%) vs Monarch target Rs 2,680. SBI Rs 1,006.40 (+2.80%) vs Rs 1,265. NSE close, 5 Nov 2026. Targets are brokerage opinions.
 Updated: 20 Nov 2026 • 5:24 pm
 Posted by: Chaitanya Auti 
 Quick Answer 
 Monarch Muhurat picks for Samvat 2083 include HDFC AMC, BEL, SBI and Vedanta Aluminium, and the brokerage's Samvat 2083 themes are the 8th Pay Commission and BFSI. Monarch Networth Capital lists 13 stocks with targets, but HDFC AMC has already risen to Rs 2,640, close to its Rs 2,680 target.
 Monarch Muhurat picks for Samvat 2083 include HDFC AMC, BEL, SBI and Vedanta Aluminium, and the brokerage's Samvat 2083 themes are the 8th Pay Commission and BFSI. Monarch Networth Capital named 13 stocks with target prices, according to Business Today. Prices below are NSE data at the NSE close on 5 November 2026. This guide covers the picks, the themes, how far each stock has already moved and the risks. It is not investment advice.

 Monarch's Samvat 2083 Picks: Targets and Today's Prices 
 Monarch Networth Capital sees potential for a market rally and wealth creation after the sharp corrections of Samvat 2082. The table shows its targets for the stocks named in the headline, with the NSE closing price and the gap to the target by our arithmetic. The brokerage's targets are its own opinions, and the sources did not give a time frame.

 HDFC AMC jumped 5.39% on 5 November, so most of the gap to Monarch's target has closed. That matters for anyone reading the headline today, because the picks were published before this move. A pick with a small gap left is a different proposition from one with a wide gap. The remaining seven names were Aster DM Quality Care (Rs 835), Bharti Airtel (Rs 2,270), Blue Star (Rs 1,911), Indegene (Rs 691), Pricol (Rs 800), TBO Tek (Rs 2,043) and VA Tech Wabag (Rs 2,235), but the source gave no current prices for them.
 Compare these stocks on the Univest Screener 
 Samvat 2083 Theme 1: The 8th Pay Commission 
 Monarch expects the 8th Pay Commission recommendations to be accepted in FY28, which would raise incomes for more than 2 crore employees and pensioners. It sees the extra spending flowing into autos, travel and tourism, premium beverages and consumer durables. This is a forecast, since the timing and size of any pay revision are not certain.
 Samvat 2083 Theme 2: BFSI 
 The second theme is banking, financial services and insurance. Monarch cites credit and deposit growth above 15%, asset quality at multi-year bests, valuations below average and leadership changes at several institutions. It also sees select capital-market businesses as steady compounders. The SBI and HDFC AMC picks fit this theme. The Nifty Bank index rose 3.33% on 5 November.
 Monarch's Market View for Samvat 2083 
 Point 
 Monarch's view 
 Nifty 12-month forward P/E 
 Fell from 24.8x in late 2024 to 17.2x by September 2026 
 Earnings 
 Resilient despite weak index returns, so returns are expected to be earnings-driven 
 Foreign flows 
 India's MSCI Emerging Markets weight halved from about 20% to about 11% 
 Positioning 
 Sentiment looks more stretched than fundamentals 
 Advice 
 Moderate return expectations and disciplined asset allocation 
 The report gave no index target. Index levels on 5 November 2026 were: Nifty 50 at 24,536.60, up 2.40%, and Sensex at 79,310.01, up 2.60%.

 Muhurat trading takes place on Sunday, 8 November 2026, per NSE and BSE circulars reported by the press, with the main session from 2:20 PM to 3:30 PM. Monarch Networth Capital is itself a listed company, at Rs 353.50 on the NSE, up 0.77%, and it is not one of the picks.
 Conclusion 
 Monarch Muhurat picks combine the 8th Pay Commission and BFSI themes with targets that range from about 1.5% to about 46.6% above today's prices for the six stocks named. Check each stock's price against its target, read the brokerage report and decide your position size before acting.

 Frequently Asked Questions on Monarch Muhurat Picks 
 What are Monarch Networth Capital's Samvat 2083 picks? 
 Ans. Business Today reported that Monarch named 13 stocks: Aster DM Quality Care, Bharat Electronics, Bharti Airtel, Blue Star, Carborundum Universal, CCL Products, HDFC AMC, Indegene, Pricol, State Bank of India, TBO Tek, Vedanta Aluminium and VA Tech Wabag. Targets range from Rs 449 for BEL to Rs 2,680 for HDFC AMC.
 What are Monarch's key Samvat 2083 themes? 
 Ans. The two key themes are the 8th Pay Commission and BFSI. Monarch expects the pay commission recommendations to be accepted in FY28, boosting spending for more than 2 crore employees and pensioners. It likes BFSI for credit growth above 15%, better asset quality and below-average valuations.
 What is the HDFC AMC target and price? 
 Ans. Monarch's target for HDFC AMC is Rs 2,680 and the stock closed at Rs 2,640 on the NSE on 5 November 2026, up 5.39%. By our arithmetic the gap to the target is about 1.5%, so much of the move has already happened.
 What is the SBI target in Monarch's list? 
 Ans. The target is Rs 1,265 against an NSE close of Rs 1,006.40 on 5 November 2026, a gap of about 25.7% by our arithmetic. SBI rose 2.80% that day. Business Today's report said it had touched Rs 987.75 earlier in the week.
 What do the BEL and Vedanta Aluminium targets imply? 
 Ans. BEL's target of Rs 449 is about 13.6% above its Rs 395.10 close, and Vedanta Aluminium's target of Rs 525 is about 38.5% above its Rs 379.10 close. Targets are opinions and depend on orders, aluminium prices and execution.
 Does Monarch give a Nifty target for Samvat 2083? 
 Ans. The report gave no index target. It said the Nifty's forward P/E fell from 24.8x to 17.2x, earnings stayed resilient, and returns should be earnings-driven. It advised moderate return expectations and disciplined asset allocation.
 What are the risks to these Muhurat picks? 
 Ans. Key risks are tax friction from overlapping securities transaction tax and capital gains tax, elevated energy prices, an unwinding of the AI-driven global rally and the possibility that a stock has already moved close to its target. Individual stocks carry their own business risks.
 Should I buy the Monarch picks for Muhurat trading? 
 Ans. Univest cannot give personal advice. Targets are one brokerage's opinions, and some stocks have already moved. Read the research report, check current prices and consult a SEBI-registered adviser before acting.
